item.title: Supplements That Should NOT Be Taken Together
item.description:
Why Timing and Combinations Matter

Not all supplements play well together. Some compete for absorption, others can cause imbalances, and some combinations can even be harmful. Understanding these interactions helps you get the most from your supplements — and stay safe.

Absorption Competitors

These supplements compete for the same absorption pathways. Taking them together reduces how much of each you actually absorb.

Calcium vs. Iron

The Problem: Calcium significantly reduces iron absorption — by as much as 50-60%.

item.title: Zinc + Copper: The Essential Balancing Act
item.description:
Why Balance Matters

Zinc and copper are both essential minerals, but they have a unique relationship: they compete for absorption in the intestines. This means supplementing one can deplete the other.

This isn’t a synergy stack — it’s a safety stack. Understanding zinc-copper balance prevents a common supplementation mistake that can cause serious problems.
